body:
After `/formalize` is working, we can do automated translation based on wikidata.

In http://github.com/link-assistant/human-language we have switching languages of entities, predicates and facts about them. This way we get rough way of formalized translation.

As now we have /formalize, we can use it to as a first step for translation. As we now can get translations for each entities and predicates.

Yet for perfect translation we may need to use Links Notation manipulation of CST of the entire expression (that should come as result of formalize, if it does not that should be fixed, yet all the tests and other features should be keep working.

Links notation version of formalization should contain enough information for generating markdown from it and so making translation of each term.

After we have rough translation, we can have transformation rules, see at examples how we do that at: http://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli (unversal turing complete match and substitution patterns) and http://github.com/link-foundation/start (converting some natural language expressions to commands).

Everything we cannot define or formalize with /formalize or the function of it we should keep as variables, that yet to be defined.

Also formalization step should have list of questions generated for these variables or undefined parts.

If you see some tests that are obviously wrong, please don't be shy to drive them to perfection. Formalization and translation  assisted by transformation rules should be as perfect, correct and formally verifiable as we can possible do, we should not have any fake tests, as we a developing tool, that people will rely on in the pursuit of truth, facts, accuracy.

Double check our requirements fully reflect all my requirements from all issues and comments I have told in this repository.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in a single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Add `/translate` section + improve /formalize
